archiveTitle: Daily Brief | Sony cancels development of Fairgame$

entries.headline: Marathon's Symbiosis update launches December 8 with PvE Expedition and 3v3 Deathmatch
entries.summary: Bungie says Symbiosis adds the three-run PvE-only Expedition mode, a 3v3 Team Deathmatch beta, the Limbo social space, the Bishop Runner shell, and two weapons. An Open Play Week runs from December 8 through 15.
entries.verification: The opened first-party PlayStation Blog post directly lists the launch date, modes, equipment, and Open Play Week window.
entries.timeNote: Published at 22:00 Beijing time on November 10, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: The Outer Worlds 2's first DLC, Side Effects Guaranteed, launches December 2
entries.summary: The first of two narrative expansions raises the level cap and adds flaws, perks, weapons, armor, and a Sub Rosa storyline. The second expansion is planned for spring 2027.
entries.verification: Opened first-party posts from Xbox Wire and PlayStation Blog agree on the DLC name, December 2 date, and two-part structure.
entries.timeNote: Xbox Wire published at 02:00 Beijing time on November 11; the PlayStation post followed in the same hour.

entries.headline: Football Manager 27 and its console edition are out now and included with Game Pass
entries.summary: Xbox Wire highlights Tactical Tweaks, training tied to a manager's tactical philosophy, and Shuffle Draft league and knockout formats for two to 32 players.
entries.verification: The opened first-party Xbox Wire post confirms availability, Game Pass inclusion, and the listed features.
entries.timeNote: Published at 04:00 Beijing time on November 11, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Warhammer Survivors launches on Xbox Series X|S and Xbox Game Pass
entries.summary: Auroch Digital says the licensed survivors-like game brings characters and factions from Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer: Age of Sigmar to Xbox Series X|S and Game Pass.
entries.verification: The opened first-party developer post on Xbox Wire confirms the release status, platform, Game Pass availability, and licensing partners.
entries.timeNote: Published at 18:00 Beijing time on November 10, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Bloomberg reports Sony canceled Fairgame$ as Haven shifts to a support role
entries.summary: Gematsu relays Bloomberg's report that Sony stopped development of Fairgame$. A Sony spokesperson said there would be no layoffs and Haven would support other studios; an internal email cited playtest feedback and retention below target along with difficult PvP shooter market conditions.
entries.verification: The opened Gematsu article identifies Bloomberg as the original report and separates the Sony spokesperson's statement from the internal email reviewed by Bloomberg. The 3DM relay is not counted as independent confirmation.
entries.timeNote: Published at 04:58 Beijing time on November 11, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Sensor Tower estimates Grand Theft Auto VI preorders at 9.69 million and $942 million
entries.summary: A Denfaminicogamer report cites a November 10 Sensor Tower tracker snapshot estimating roughly 9.69 million PlayStation and Xbox preorders and $942 million in post-refund revenue, including about 7.23 million PlayStation orders and 2.46 million Xbox orders. These are third-party estimates, not publisher-reported sales.
entries.verification: The opened report names Sensor Tower, states the snapshot date and methodology boundary, and provides the platform split. An unrelated 3DM source about online modes was not used.
entries.timeNote: Published at 07:17 Beijing time on November 11; the data snapshot is dated November 10.

entries.headline: Dragon Quest RPG: The Cursed Tree and the Chosen Isle targets a global 2027 launch
entries.summary: Square Enix announced the free-to-play command RPG for iOS and Android, with item purchases and a simultaneous global release planned for 2027. A closed beta test runs from December 8 through 15, and applications are open.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report explicitly relays Square Enix's announcement and states the platforms, business model, launch year, and closed-beta dates.
entries.timeNote: Published at 19:15 Beijing time on November 10, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Medarot Classics Plus brings two eight-game collections to Steam in December
entries.summary: Imagineer announced Steam editions of the Kabuto and Kuwagata versions for December 2026. Each version contains eight early-series games and adds online battles and trading, marking the franchise's first Steam release.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report explicitly relays Imagineer's announcement, the two editions, game count, online functions, and release window.
entries.timeNote: Published at 11:00 Beijing time on November 10, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: Epic releases Unreal Engine 5.9 MegaJam Preview with expanded AI-agent workflows
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that the preview updates Unreal MCP, lets Unreal Assistant invoke Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and OpenCode from the editor, and introduces the shared Unreal Canvas workspace for users and AI agents. Epic positioned it as an experimental build prepared for the 2026 Epic AI MegaJam.
entries.verification: The opened AUTOMATON report explicitly relays Epic Games' release, the named tools, supported agents, and experimental positioning.
entries.timeNote: Published at 19:54 Beijing time on November 10, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: PlayStation Plus Game Catalog - November 2026: Sony reveals a six-game PlayStation Plus lineup for November
entries.summary: IGN's report lists Death Stranding 2: On the Beach, Like a Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii, Dragon Quest III HD-2D Remake, Atomfall, Trepang2, and MotoGP 26. The fixed evidence does not state each title's availability date or tier.
entries.verification: The opened IGN article attributes the lineup to Sony and names all six games, but the packet does not include the underlying official page or per-title dates.
entries.timeNote: Published at 03:33 Beijing time on November 11, inside the fixed edition window.

entries.headline: PICK A BOO launches on Steam with up to six-player cooperative furniture hauling
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that Game & Co. released Toydium's cooperative action game on November 9. Up to six online players evade surveillance and enemies while carrying furniture and keepsakes to a truck across procedurally generated stages; the Steam launch discount runs through November 16.
entries.verification: The opened report states the publisher, developer, November 9 launch, Steam platform, six-player limit, and launch-sale window.
entries.timeNote: Published at 14:26 Beijing time on November 10, inside the fixed edition window; the launch date is confirmed only to November 9.

entries.headline: 1999トコヨビル launches on Steam for PC
entries.summary: 4Gamer reports that Kodansha Game Lab released the PC horror adventure on November 10 for 1,420 yen. A second promotional video and Animate merchandise details were also revealed.
entries.verification: The opened report states the publisher, November 10 Steam launch, PC platform, 1,420-yen price, and second promotional video.
entries.timeNote: Published at 11:00 Beijing time on November 10, inside the fixed edition window; the launch date is confirmed only to November 10.

entries.headline: 鳥斗突破！バード・アリーナ opens a roughly two-week public playtest on Steam
entries.summary: AUTOMATON reports that OKJOY opened a public playtest for Will Cheng's deck-building roguelike on November 10. The test offers one arena, one playable bird, 27 insects, and 30 relics, while the full release is planned for the second quarter of 2027.
entries.verification: The opened report states the publisher, developer, playtest date and duration, test content, and 2027 second-quarter launch plan.
entries.timeNote: Published at 11:00 Beijing time on November 10, inside the fixed edition window; the playtest's stated 12:00 start was not safely converted from the fixed evidence.

entries.headline: Arknights announces another Monster Hunter collaboration
entries.summary: Yostar announced on November 10 that Hypergryph's Arknights will receive a new collaboration with the Monster Hunter series. Details will be revealed later, marking another crossover after the September 2023 event.
entries.verification: The opened report attributes the collaboration announcement to Yostar and explicitly says further details will come later.
entries.timeNote: Published at 16:53 Beijing time on November 10, inside the fixed edition window; the announcement date is confirmed only to November 10.

entries.headline: Take-Two forecasts up to $3.5 billion in quarterly net bookings as Grand Theft Auto VI launches
entries.summary: Take-Two expects $3.35 billion to $3.5 billion in net bookings for the October-December 2026 quarter, up from about $1.76 billion a year earlier, with Grand Theft Auto VI's November 19 launch as the main driver. Recurrent consumer spending is forecast to rise about 12%.
entries.verification: The opened report attributes the figures to Take-Two's earnings release, distinguishes net bookings from accounting revenue, and states the forecast range and driver.
entries.timeNote: Published at 13:47 Beijing time on November 10, inside the fixed edition window; the forecast covers the October-December 2026 quarter.

entries.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI targets 30 fps across consoles, including PS5 Pro
entries.summary: Rockstar confirmed a 30 fps target on every console, including PS5 Pro. The PS5 Pro version still offers exclusive graphics features such as ray-traced shadows and PSSR, but the fixed evidence does not identify a 60 fps or 40 fps mode.
entries.verification: The opened report attributes the 30 fps target to Rockstar and says it covers all consoles, including PS5 Pro.
entries.timeNote: Published at 01:16 Beijing time on November 11, inside the fixed edition window; the specification was confirmed on November 10.

entries.headline: Grand Theft Auto VI sets PlayStation Store and Microsoft Store preorder records
entries.summary: Sony confirmed it is the most preordered game in PlayStation Store history without providing a count, while Microsoft confirmed the same record for the Microsoft Store. These official platform records use a different basis from Sensor Tower's third-party preorder estimate.
entries.verification: The opened report attributes the two store records to Sony and Microsoft and states that Sony did not disclose a preorder count.
entries.timeNote: Published at 23:56 Beijing time on November 10, inside the fixed edition window; neither platform holder disclosed an official preorder count in the fixed evidence.
